Triage: **`pm:queue`** — execution card of an already-made ruling, not a new decision.

- **Classification**: the rule "outbound agent text follows the CONVERSATION language, labels follow the UI locale" was established by #772 / #2884 and is written at the gate site itself; this card is two measured violations of it (UI-pack `t()` as the non-zh fallback on three gated sites; `planAnswerMessage` not gated at all). Sending it back to the decision box would be the #4829 failure shape.
- **Anchors verified on `origin/main` @ `50fa376`** (note the real path — the filing's bare `AiChatPage.tsx:1581` is `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`; lines shifted slightly): `convZh` memo at `:1594`, the three gated outbound sites from `:1598` (each falling back to `t()`), and the ungated `planAnswerMessage` at `:2215-2216`. The zh pack defining all four keys — the premise that breaks the "MISS in every non-Chinese pack" design — is exactly as the card states.
- **Fix shape carried non-binding**: one conversation-language resolver for all four sites (zh value when conv is zh, en value otherwise — never the UI pack), plus re-stating the test's self-description to what it actually guarantees.
- **Dedup**: `planAnswerMessage` search returns only this card; #3837 (label half) is merged and explicitly excluded this half; #3546 slice 4 is the key-coverage sweep, different concern.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。
